notes: Must use an authorized signing identity; do not uninstall without approval.
Preserve app data and record the previous/new version.
Expect bounded diagnostic or safe failure, not permanent black screen.
Exercise Back/parent teardown as well as explicit buttons.
Record elapsed time and memory pressure.
Verify next boot avoids a repeated warmup crash loop.
Separate surface teardown from an earlier causal failure.
Verify stale assembly/PCK detection before launch.
Verify bounded ANR trace on the following boot.
Verify low-memory reason is distinguished from crash.
